hooks.command: $input_json = $input | Out-String; $data = $input_json | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = $data.tool_input.command; $ports = @{8080='Backend (Spring Boot)'; 5173='Frontend (Vite)'}; $conflicts = @(); foreach ($port in $ports.Keys) { try { $listeners = [System.Net.NetworkInformation.IPGlobalProperties]::GetIPGlobalProperties().GetActiveTcpListeners(); if ($listeners | Where-Object { $_.Port -eq $port }) { $conflicts += "Port $port ($($ports[$port])) is already occupied" } } catch {} }; if ($conflicts.Count -gt 0) { $msg = 'PORT CONFLICT DETECTED: ' + ($conflicts -join '; ') + '. Stop conflicting process first (Get-Process | Where-Object ... | Stop-Process -Force), then retry on the designated port. Never use an alternative port.'; $out = @{systemMessage=$msg} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out } 2>$null
